description: This file implements an in-memory caching mechanism, including cache setting, getting, eviction, TTL management, and asynchronous methods, for use within a larger software project.

classes.name: InMemoryCache
classes.description: A class implementing an in-memory cache with TTL, eviction policies, and support for both synchronous and asynchronous operations.

methods.name: check_value_size(self, value: Any)
methods.description: Checks if a value exceeds the maximum allowed size for cache storage.

methods.name: bool _is_key_expired(self, key: str)
methods.description: Checks if a specific cache key has expired based on TTL.

methods.name: None _remove_key(self, key: str)
methods.description: Removes a cache key from cache and TTL dictionaries.

methods.name: evict_cache(self)
methods.description: Implements eviction policy based on expiration and cache size limits.

methods.name: bool allow_ttl_override(self, key: str)
methods.description: Determines if TTL override is allowed for a specific key.

methods.name: set_cache(self, key, value, **kwargs)
methods.description: Sets a cache key with a value and optional TTL.

methods.name: async_set_cache(self, key, value, **kwargs)
methods.description: Asynchronously sets a cache key.

methods.name: async_set_cache_pipeline(self, cache_list, ttl=None, **kwargs)
methods.description: Sets multiple cache keys asynchronously in a pipeline.

methods.name: async_set_cache_sadd(self, key, value: List, ttl: Optional[float])
methods.description: Adds multiple items to a set stored in cache asynchronously.

methods.name: bool evict_element_if_expired(self, key: str)
methods.description: Removes a key if it is expired.

methods.name: get_cache(self, key, **kwargs)
methods.description: Retrieves a cached value by key, handling expiration.

methods.name: batch_get_cache(self, keys: list, **kwargs)
methods.description: Retrieves multiple cached values.

methods.name: int increment_cache(self, key, value: int, **kwargs)
methods.description: Increments a numeric cache value.

methods.name: async_get_cache(self, key, **kwargs)
methods.description: Asynchronously retrieves a cached value.

methods.name: async_batch_get_cache(self, keys: list, **kwargs)
methods.description: Asynchronously retrieves multiple cached values.

methods.name: float async_increment(self, key, value: float, **kwargs)
methods.description: Asynchronously increments a cached numeric value.

methods.name: Optional[List[float]] async_increment_pipeline( self, increment_list: List["RedisPipelineIncrementOperation"], **kwargs )
methods.description: Performs multiple increments asynchronously in a pipeline.

methods.name: flush_cache(self)
methods.description: Clears all cache and TTL data.

methods.name: disconnect(self)
methods.description: Placeholder for disconnect logic, does nothing currently.

methods.name: delete_cache(self, key)
methods.description: Deletes a specific cache key.

methods.name: Optional[int] async_get_ttl(self, key: str)
methods.description: Retrieves the TTL of a cache key asynchronously.

methods.name: List[str] async_get_oldest_n_keys(self, n: int)
methods.description: Retrieves the oldest N cache keys based on TTL.
